capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Express anxiety about the order and request status.
steps.text: Hello, என்னோட order ORD-30003 எங்கே இருக்கு? எனக்கு இன்னைக்கு கண்டிப்பா வேணும். நான் first time order பண்றேன், ரொம்ப பயமா இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge anxiety and offer to check.
steps.text: வணக்கம். நீங்க first time order பண்றதுனால கவலை படாதீங்க. நான் உங்க order details check பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Urge the agent to check quickly.
steps.text: சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க. எனக்கு running shoes ரொம்ப urgent.

steps.purpose: Ask the customer to wait while looking up.
steps.text: ஒரு நிமிஷம் line ல இருங்க, நான் system ல பார்க்குறேன்.

steps.purpose: Fetch order details.
Return order details.
Inform the customer about the current status.
steps.text: உங்க order details கிடைச்சிடுச்சு. உங்க running shoes order out_for_delivery status ல இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Ask for confirmation of order details and delivery.
steps.text: Oh, out_for_delivery னா இன்னைக்கு வந்துடுமா? இது 3299 rupees prepaid order, correct ஆ?

steps.purpose: Confirm order details and days since order.
steps.text: ஆமா, இது 3299 rupees prepaid order தான். நீங்க order பண்ணி 2 days ஆகுது.

steps.purpose: State that delivery hasn't happened and ask to track.
steps.text: ஆமா 2 days ஆச்சு. எனக்கு இன்னும் delivery ஆகல. என்ன problem னு track பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Request verification before tracking.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா track பண்றேன். ஒரு சிறிய verification, உங்க registered_pincode சொல்லுங்க?

steps.purpose: Provide pincode for verification.
steps.text: என்னோட pincode 600042. இது தான் நான் கொடுத்த pincode.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity.
Return verification result.
Acknowledge successful verification.
steps.text: நன்றி. உங்க identity verified ஆயிடுச்சு. இப்போ நான் courier details track பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Fetch shipment tracking details.
Return shipment tracking details.

result.last_scan: out for delivery at local hub

steps.purpose: Provide detailed tracking info to the customer.
steps.text: உங்க package BlueDart courier கிட்ட இருக்கு. Last scan படி local hub ல இருந்து out for delivery ஆயிடுச்சு. எந்த exception உம் இல்லை.

steps.purpose: Ask about delivery today and request address verification.
steps.text: அப்போ இன்னைக்கு delivery ஆகிடுமா? எனக்கு ஒரு சின்ன doubt, address correct ஆ இருக்கா னு verify பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Clarify address visibility and state current status without forward guarantees.
steps.expected_behavior: State only what tools confirm without making forward guarantees.
steps.text: என்னால full address பார்க்க முடியாது, ஆனா courier side ல இருந்து address exception எதுவும் report ஆகல. Promised time 4 days, இப்போ 2 days தான் ஆகியிருக்கு. Status out for delivery ல இருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: Fixing the ungrounded claim by stating the address isn't fully visible but there's no address exception, and removing the delivery guarantee.

steps.purpose: Ask clarifying question about the delivery window and complaint.
steps.text: Oh, promised time 4 days ஆ? அப்போ நான் இன்னும் 2 days wait பண்ணனுமா? இன்னைக்கு வரலனா complaint raise பண்ண முடியாதா?

steps.purpose: Explain the business rule regarding complaints.
steps.text: இல்ல, இப்போ complaint raise பண்ண முடியாது. Promised 4 days முடிஞ்ச பிறகு தான் complaint raise பண்ண முடியும்.

steps.purpose: Request the agent to contact the courier.
steps.text: ஆனா எனக்கு இன்னைக்கு தேவை. BlueDart கிட்ட பேசி confirm பண்ண முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Decline the request and reassure based on no exceptions.
steps.text: எங்களுக்கு delivery agent கிட்ட direct ஆ பேச முடியாது. ஆனா exception 'none' னு இருக்குறதால, system படி எந்த delay உம் இல்லை. Order out for delivery ல தான் இருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: Removing the forward guarantee about delivery happening within the promised time.

steps.purpose: Apologize for asking many questions.
steps.text: Okay, புரியுது. நான் first time order பண்றதால தான் இவ்வளவு கேள்வி கேட்குறேன். தப்பா நினைக்காதீங்க.

steps.purpose: Validate customer's feelings and confirm order status.
steps.text: பரவாயில்லை, இது உங்க உரிமை. உங்க order out_for_delivery ல இருக்கு, நீங்க wait பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Agree to wait and end the conversation.
steps.text: சரி, நான் wait பண்றேன். Thanks for the information.

ir.terminal_condition: Customer told exactly where the shipment is and what happens next.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The agent and user naturally blend English nouns with Tamil verbs (e.g., 'check பண்றேன்', 'track பண்ணுங்க', 'complaint raise பண்ண').
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Code Switch Response Style > Natural Verb Construction

variant_findings.reason: The agent violates the grounding constraint by confirming the address is correct (which no tool returned) and by making forward guarantees about delivery ('கண்டிப்பா வந்துடும்', 'delivery ஆகிடும்'), which directly contradicts the variant's rule against guarantees about what happens after the call ends.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent confirms the address is correct despite no tool returning address information. Additionally, the agent makes forward guarantees about the delivery happening within the promised window, violating the strict Tool Output Grounding variant constraints.
issues.repair_instruction: Starting from e20, the agent must state that they cannot view the full address but can confirm there are no address-related exceptions reported by the courier. Remove any forward guarantees about delivery; the agent should only state what the tools currently show (that it is out for delivery and still within the 4-day promised window).

verification.summary: The conversation successfully adopts the requested persona and code-switching style. However, it fails the Tool Output Grounding variant because the agent hallucinates address verification and makes forward guarantees about delivery outcomes. A suffix repair is needed to strictly ground the agent's responses in the tool outputs.

variant_findings.reason: The conversation consistently blends English nouns with native Tamil verbs naturally (e.g., 'check பண்றேன்', 'track பண்ணுங்க', 'verified ஆயிடுச்சு', 'complaint raise பண்ண').
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Code Switch Response Style > Natural Verb Construction

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds its responses in the tool output, explicitly refusing to verify the address because it is not visible in the tool data, and refusing to guarantee delivery today, citing only the 'none' exception and the promised time.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The dialogue contains raw enum values with underscores spoken by both the user and the agent (e.g., 'out_for_delivery' and 'registered_pincode'), which is unnatural for spoken text.
issues.repair_instruction: Replace the underscored enum values with natural spoken English words (e.g., change 'out_for_delivery' to 'out for delivery' and 'registered_pincode' to 'registered pincode').

issues.detail: The STT profile is set to LIGHT, which requires minor transcription errors in the user's speech, but the clean_text and model_visible_text are completely identical across all user turns.
issues.repair_instruction: Introduce 1-2 plausible, minor STT errors in the user's `model_visible_text` (e.g., phonetically similar word substitutions or slight misrecognitions) to correctly reflect the LIGHT STT profile.

verification.summary: The conversation effectively demonstrates the target variants, with excellent natural code-switching and strict adherence to tool output grounding. The persona is well-represented, and business rules are correctly applied. However, the dialogue unnaturally includes raw enum values with underscores in speech, and the LIGHT STT profile is not implemented, as there are no STT errors in the user's turns. Surface repairs are needed to fix formatting and introduce minor STT noise.

variant_findings.reason: The conversation consistently uses natural verb constructions where English nouns/verbs are combined with native Tamil verbs (e.g., 'check பண்றேன்', 'track பண்ணுங்க', 'verify பண்ணுங்க', 'complaint raise பண்ண').

In e24, the agent avoids making forward guarantees about delivery, stating only that there is no delay per the system and the status remains out for delivery.

verification.summary: The conversation is well-constructed and strictly adheres to the business rules and constraints.
